mapper.sql: wu.id, wu.relation_id AS relationId, wu.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, wu.user_id AS userId, wu.role_type AS roleType, wu.status, wu.remark, wu.create_time AS createTime
mapper.select: SELECT , w.node_name AS warehouseName, u.user_name AS userName, u.actual_name AS actualName FROM spd_warehouse_user wu LEFT JOIN spd_org_node w ON wu.warehouse_id = w.node_id LEFT JOIN t_employee u ON wu.user_id = u.employee_id WHERE wu.id = #{id} AND wu.del_flag = 0

SELECT , w.node_name AS warehouseName, u.user_name AS userName, u.actual_name AS actualName FROM spd_warehouse_user wu LEFT JOIN spd_org_node w ON wu.warehouse_id = w.node_id LEFT JOIN t_employee u ON wu.user_id = u.employee_id WHERE wu.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND wu.del_flag = #{delFlag} AND wu.status = 1 ORDER BY wu.role_type ASC

SELECT , w.node_name AS warehouseName, u.user_name AS userName, u.actual_name AS actualName FROM spd_warehouse_user wu LEFT JOIN spd_org_node w ON wu.warehouse_id = w.node_id LEFT JOIN t_employee u ON wu.user_id = u.employee_id WHERE wu.user_id = #{userId} AND wu.del_flag = #{delFlag} AND wu.status = 1 ORDER BY wu.create_time DESC
